description: Agent Recovery: submit a system’s recovery records (each with its id, the task interrupted, when, what failed, what was done: resumed, restarted, rolled back or abandoned, where a resume picked up, what was lost, what changed afterward and when the record was written) and optionally the interruptions seen in other logs, such as alerts, error logs or a tracker. The signed report counts every recovery that keeps the essentials and names every record missing what failed, what was done or what was lost (the core a recovery cannot be reconstructed without), every record missing what changed afterward, every record written more than a day after the interruption, and every interruption seen elsewhere with no recovery record behind it, with the fix for each. This reads the record of interruptions and recoveries specifically: the record of limit events is wever_limit-evidence-check, the buyer’s record of paid calls is wever_purchase-record-check and incident claims against a timeline are wever_incident-evidence-check. Verdict recoveries_unrecorded, record_gaps, records_unverified or recoveries_recorded. POST /api/recovery-record-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-recovery-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-recovery/.

changed.description: What changed afterward, such as a 30 second timeout on the hotel call.

failed.description: What failed, such as the hotel call timed out at step 3.

from.description: Where it resumed from, such as step 3.

lost.description: What was lost, such as one held fare, or none.

recovery.description: What was done: the task resumed, restarted, was rolled back or was abandoned.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

observed.description: Interruptions seen in other logs, such as alerts, error logs or a tracker, to find recoveries with no record.

name: wever_recovery-record-check
title: Recovery record check
